Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 40th Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2024] No. 112

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon deliberation and decision by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, five cases, including Jiang's justifiable defense case (Guiding Cases No. 225-229), are hereby issued as the 40th batch of guiding cases for reference in adjudicating similar cases.

May 30, 2024
